items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: We had a little band we made up. You remember, you heard of Johnny Deve?

ctx.x: I'm wondering about some of the other bands you played with then after, oh, who was the first band? The big arts that you played with, you mentioned that you stayed with them a while. If you want to go on and tell about a few of the other bands.
Well, there's so many of them that I played with. We had a little band we made up. You remember, you heard of Johnny Deve?
Yes, they played the banjo with Sam Morgan, I know.
